name: Detached Re-voxelize
definition: A rendering technique for detached solids that re-voxelizes geometry into a grid, resolves occlusion via a distance buffer, and projects to trixels. It uses round-to-cell mapping for grid placement and an exposed-face mask to gate emission.
summary: Detached re-voxelize renders detached solids by re-voxelizing geometry with round-to-cell mapping and recomputing exposed-face masks to fix coverage holes and stale-mask artifacts.
